subject: CPPO eligibility + co-sell playbook for ACME (reseller request)
thread_text:
From: partners@cloudnova-svcs.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.example
Date: 2027-12-01 09:03:22 -0800
Subject: Quick: CPPO for ACME - need reseller eligibility confirmation

Hi Jonas,

Hope you’re well. ACME is moving to purchase via the AWS Channel Private Offer route and they asked to work with CloudNova as their reseller. Before we open the PPPO, AWS asked us for a short eligibility checklist and evidence items so they can approve CloudNova as a reseller on the CPPO.

Key asks from ACME/AWS:
- Confirmation Redwood supports CPPO for the requested SKU bundle and pricing model
- Reseller authorization evidence (MOU/partner agreement + tax entity)
- Entitlement mapping: which SKUs need marketplace entitlements vs. direct seat provisioning
- A DocuSign link for reseller onboarding is preferred

Can you confirm what we should provide (and any speed bumps to expect)?

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Sr. Partner Ops
CloudNova Services

---
From: jonas_weber@redwood.example
To: ben_carter@redwood.example, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example, evelyn_hart@redwood.example
Date: 2027-12-01 11:10:05 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Quick: CPPO for ACME - need reseller eligibility confirmation

Team — forwarding CloudNova's note. I want to assemble a short CPPO checklist we can hand to AWS + the reseller so there are no back-and-forth delays. Attaching a draft evidence request (CPPO-evidence-request.pdf).

Proposed quick checklist (one-pager):
- Confirmed Redwood model variant is in our AWS listing catalog (sku set + model version)
- Reseller authorization: signed reseller agreement or partnership letter + tax ID (W-9/EU VAT if applicable)
- Proof of account mapping: which AWS account the CPPO will bill to (our deal_id mapping)
- Entitlement matrix: marketplace SKU vs entitlement token requirements (simple table)
- Pricing floor confirmation: any minimum discount rules we must honor for CPPO
- DocuSign: reseller onboarding + MSA addendum

Questions for Ben/Vanessa:
- Ben: can you confirm the entitlement mapping and whether we need to raise a special SKU in the marketplace for the bundle?
- Vanessa: partner onboarding / PoV for CloudNova — any pre-reqs or current partner tier issues?
- Evelyn: any legal language we need to include in the reseller attestation?

If we can get this to CloudNova today, AWS typically approves CPPOs in 48-72 hours.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Channel Partnerships Lead | Redwood Inference

Attachment: CPPO-evidence-request.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)

---
On Thu, Dec 2, 2027 at 08:45 AM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example> wrote:
> Jonas / team,
>
> Quick answers:
> - Entitlement mapping: the bundle references three marketplace SKUs (in our catalog IDs: RDW-MSK-01, RDW-MSK-02, RDW-MSK-03). Two require marketplace entitlement tokens (MSK-02 and MSK-03).
> - For the bundle, we generally recommend using the existing SKU set; no new SKU required unless the customer needs a custom price component tied to usage metrics.
> - Pricing floor: Channel CPPOs must not undercut our minimum channel price; see attached guidance (price_floor_guidance.xlsx). If CloudNova requests an exception we need a documented approval and a 30-day grace window for billing reconciliation.
>
> I'll add the SKU entitlement notes into the checklist and flag the parts that require Partner Ops action.
>
> -Ben
> Ben Carter
> Senior Partner Sales
> Attachment: price_floor_guidance.xlsx

To: partners@cloudnova-svcs.com, procurement@acme-corp.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.example, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example
Date: 2027-12-02 10:22:14 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick: CPPO for ACME - need reseller eligibility confirmation

Hi Maya / ACME team — thanks for the note and the patience.

Attached is a compact reseller CPPO checklist (reseller_cppo_checklist.pdf) that outlines the evidence and steps AWS will expect. Highlights:
- Redwood confirms the bundle is available as listed (RDW-MSK-01/02/03). MSK-02 & MSK-03 require entitlement tokens; CloudNova must provide the mapping to the ACME AWS account so entitlements can be activated.
- Required docs from reseller: signed reseller agreement or partner letter, proof of tax entity, and a completed reseller attestation (we included a DocuSign link).
- Pricing: per Ben, pricing floor applies. If CloudNova needs a margin exception we’ll need explicit approval (documented in this thread) and a HubSpot approval record.

Next steps — please action these items:
1) CloudNova: upload signed reseller agreement + tax ID to the shared Drive folder and sign the DocuSign onboarding packet (link below).
2) ACME: confirm which AWS account to bill and provide the account ID for entitlement mapping.
3) Redwood: Ben/Vanessa will finalize the entitlement matrix and I’ll open the HubSpot record (ID below) and kick off DocuSign.

DocuSign: https://docusign.example/link/ENVELOPE-98765
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood.example/deal/123456789
Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.example/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d-cosell-assets

Jonas Weber
Channel Partnerships Lead | Redwood Inference

Attachment: reseller_cppo_checklist.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

> 2) For the entitlement mapping, can Redwood provide the example JSON or template we should submit to AWS? ACME's cloud team prefers a sample payload to avoid back-and-forth.

> Maya
